limitations: Short steady-state test, not thermal endurance or accuracy qualification.
Maximum measured throughput among tested capture rates, with raw demand at the supported 60 Hz ceiling.
At overload the bounded scheduler replaces pending inputs; sustained output FPS does not mean processing every captured pair.
Latency is capture CLOCK_BOOTTIME to Pi-local IPC descriptor availability; excludes network, payload copies and browser display.
Full includes native daemon and gateway; workstation browser resources are excluded.
Sequential physical scene, not byte-identical replay; CPU governor left ondemand.
Full repetitions share a browser and daemon session; repeated steady-state windows are not independent cold boots.
PSS apportions shared pages. Summed RSS double-counts shared mappings. Memory sampled at 1 Hz; memory cgroup controller disabled.

scene_geometry_method: OpenCV phase correlation of 2-pixel Gaussian-blurred associated left images with a Hanning window; compares scene placement across runs, not stereo calibration accuracy.
